the use of cellulose fibers as reinforcement in cement composites is still a viable option for the future and that the use of surface modification and polymer modification can improve the performance of these composites.

cellulose fibres have the potential to be used as building materials.

the surface modification of cellulose fibre is an important step in improving its performance as a reinforcing agent in cementitious materials.
